module: Editor API for the 3D axis gizmo (move / rotate / scale) and for object icons in the world view. It wraps `worldEditorCppApi`: mode and alignment selection, per-axis locks, translation/rotation/scale snapping, mouse hover/drag detection, and computation of object transforms during a move with terrain snapping (raycast or core_terrain). `initialize` installs everything on the `editor` object and defines the `editor.AxisGizmoMode_*` and `editor.AxisGizmoAlignment_*` constants.
usage:
editor.setAxisGizmoMode(editor.AxisGizmoMode_Translate)
editor.setAxisGizmoTransform(myMatrix)
-- every frame:
editor.updateAxisGizmo(onStart, onEnd, onDragging)
editor.drawAxisGizmo()
notes: Constants defined: editor.AxisX/Y/Z/W = 0/1/2/3; AxisGizmoMode_Translate/Rotate/Scale = 1/2/3; AxisGizmoAlignment_World = 0, _Local = 1; editor.objectIconHitId = 0 initially.
`updateAxisGizmo` and `drawAxisGizmo` must be called together every frame. During a drag, the simulation is paused (simTimeAuthority.pause) then restored at the end or on cancel.
onEndGizmoDragFunc is only called if the gizmo was actually dragged (objectSelectionManipulated).
The setAxisGizmo*Lock(x, y, z) locks: true = the axis is allowed (the comment says "allow").
Terrain snapping (beginGizmoTranslate/getTransformsGizmoTranslate) driven by the snapping.terrain.* preferences: enabled, useRayCast, indObjects, relRotation, keepHeight, snapToCenter, snapToBB.

In getTransformsGizmoTranslate, each object's height uses core_terrain.getTerrainHeight even in raycast mode (called before testing the raycast): without a terrain, these calls may return nil (inferred from code, a fallback value of 0 is used with `or`).
The code comment notes that getTransformsGizmoTranslate has no rotation equivalent (TODO).

initialize.desc: Remembers the editor, defines the axis/mode/alignment constants and installs all the gizmo/icon functions on `editor`.

updateObjectIcons.desc: Updates editor.objectIconHitId (object icon under the mouse, 0 if icons are hidden or the gizmos.general.drawObjectIcons preference == false) and editor.objectIconHoverId (only if no mouse button is pressed and the UI does not capture the mouse). To be called every frame.

drawObjectIcons.desc: Draws the closest objects' icons if the camera exists and editor.hideObjectIcons is not true.

setAxisGizmoTransform.desc: Places the gizmo in the world (to edit object parts or custom handles).

scale.desc: gizmo scale (default vec3(1,1,1)), avoids non-uniform scale decomposition problems

beginGizmoTranslate.desc: To be called once at the start of the drag: remembers the starting transforms and, if terrain snapping is enabled, the ground offsets, normals and bounding boxes (object collision temporarily disabled for the raycast).

getTransformsGizmoTranslate.desc: To be called every frame of the drag after beginGizmoTranslate: returns the new object transforms (gizmo translation, with terrain snapping and relative rotation according to the preferences). Returns {} if beginGizmoTranslate was not called.

updateAxisGizmo.desc: Handles the gizmo's mouse events (start, drag, end, hover), relays keyboard modifiers to C++ and emits onEditorAxisGizmoAligmentChanged if the alignment changed on the C++ side. To be called together with drawAxisGizmo.

onStartGizmoDragFunc.desc: called at the start of the drag (no arguments)

onEndGizmoDragFunc.desc: called at the end if the gizmo was dragged (no arguments)

cancelAxisGizmoInteraction.desc: Cancels an ongoing interaction: virtually releases the mouse, restores the simulation pause and deselects the gizmo element.

drawAxisGizmo.desc: Draws the gizmo with its current transform and mode (if the editor camera exists).

setAxisGizmoMode.desc: Sets the gizmo mode and emits onEditorAxisGizmoModeChanged(mode).

setAxisGizmoAlignment.desc: Sets the gizmo alignment and emits onEditorAxisGizmoAligmentChanged.

toggleAxisGizmoAlignment.desc: Toggles between world and local alignment.

toggleDrawObjectIcons.desc: Toggles the gizmos.general.drawObjectIcons preference and applies it to C++.

toggleDrawGizmoPlane.desc: Toggles the gizmos.general.drawGizmoPlane preference and enables/disables the gizmo's plane, hatching and move grid.

toggleDrawObjectText.desc: Toggles the gizmos.general.drawObjectText preference (display of object names) and applies it to C++.

isAxisGizmoHovered.desc: Returns whether a gizmo element (axis or plane) is hovered/selected.

returns.desc: true if the selected element is not -1

getAxisGizmoSelectedElement.desc: Returns the selected gizmo element (axis or plane).

toggleSnapping.desc: Enables/disables rotation and translation snapping according to the snapping.general.* preferences (rotateSnapSize, gridSize), unless the corresponding rotateSnapEnabled / snapToGrid preference is already true.

setAxisGizmoTranslateLock.desc: Allows or not translation per axis.

setAxisGizmoRotateLock.desc: Allows or not rotation per axis.

setAxisGizmoScaleLock.desc: Allows or not scaling per axis.

modifyFadeIconsDistance.desc: Adjusts the object icons fade distance (preference gizmos.objectIcons.fadeIconsDistance += delta x fadeIconsDistanceModifySpeed, clamped to 1..50000) and shows a notification.

deltaValue.desc: change (0 = nothing; no effect if editor.disableModifyFadeIconsDistance)
